Event_Locations.name: Abraxas Musical Akademie
Event_Locations.description: This venue offers five different studios that can be rented by the hour for dance, singing, or acting rehearsals. All rooms are professionally equipped with mirrored walls and are ideal for creative classes.

Event_Locations.name: Alte Färberei
Event_Locations.description: Alte Färberei is a multidisciplinary cultural hub offering workshops, exhibitions, and community-driven events. With studios, tools, and open sessions, it supports emerging artists and collaborative practices, functioning as an accessible, non-commercial space for experimentation, learning, and cultural exchange.

Event_Locations.name: Alte Utting
Event_Locations.description: Alte Utting is a former passenger ship from Lake Ammersee, relocated to a railway bridge in Munich and transformed into a cultural venue. It hosts live music, events, and private functions, offering a unique open-air setting with basic stage and technical equipment.

Event_Locations.name: Anderswo
Event_Locations.description: This flexible location provides multiple rooms equipped with whiteboards and versatile seating. It is ideally suited for workshops, intimate readings, and cooking events, offering a creative atmosphere tailored for focused, collaborative group activities.

Event_Locations.name: Artothek & Bildersaal
Event_Locations.description: A curated, non-commercial exhibition space in Munich’s old town presenting contemporary art by local professional artists. With multiple shows annually, Bildersaal fosters artistic exchange, public access, and engagement through free exhibitions, openings, and events within a central cultural setting.

Event_Locations.name: Backstage / Backstage Club
Event_Locations.description: This extremely popular cultural and event venue features multiple halls of varying sizes as well as expansive outdoor areas. The location is highly versatile, accommodating everything from small club nights to large-scale concerts.

Event_Locations.name: BIKINI MITTE
Event_Locations.description: A weekday deli serving flavorful oriental and Asian-inspired bowls, salads, and sandwiches with diverse vegetarian and meat options, plus rotating weekly dishes. From Thursday to Saturday evenings, it transforms into a relaxed bar with drinks, music, and late-night snacks.

Event_Locations.name: COKREA
Event_Locations.description: Designed to inspire collective creativity, these venues offer extensive amenities including laser projectors, design walls, and personal assistance. The spaces are specifically optimized for dynamic networking events, interactive seminars, and engaging corporate team-building sessions.

Event_Locations.name: Corleone
Event_Locations.description: Corleone Kunst Musik Bar is a creative hub near Sendlinger Tor, hosting art shows, music, readings, and interdisciplinary events. By night, it transforms into a vibrant bar with DJs, projections, and a lively urban atmosphere for artists and curious visitors alike.

Event_Locations.name: DNA
Event_Locations.description: As one of the newest techno clubs in Munich, this venue is hidden in the basement of Werksviertel. Equipped with an excellent Lambda Labs sound system and a DJ booth, it is a highlight for electronic music.

Event_Locations.name: EineWeltHaus
Event_Locations.description: EineWeltHaus Munich is an intercultural community center focused on migration and global exchange. It offers a library, shared resources, counseling, and affordable spaces, with the foyer hosting monthly changing exhibitions that highlight diverse perspectives, creativity, and socially engaged artistic practices.

Event_Locations.name: Einsatz Club
Event_Locations.description: This versatile club venue features two separate indoor spaces and its own outdoor area. Flexible rental options, ranging from hourly to full-day bookings, make it ideal for concerts, workshops, and private parties.

Event_Locations.name: Einstein Kultur
Event_Locations.description: This cultural venue offers four fully equipped halls that can be booked for theatre performances, concerts, workshops, and private events. Professional support is also guaranteed from September through July.

Event_Locations.name: Exposé im Rumford
Event_Locations.description: Serving as a dynamic gallery for both emerging and established artists, this venue features flexible exhibition hanging systems. With weekly changing shows, it offers an alternative platform for creatives looking to bypass traditional, restrictive art market structures.

Event_Locations.name: FABINESA Studio
Event_Locations.description: Featuring professional-grade sound and lighting systems, this modern studio is perfectly tailored for dance, yoga, and theatrical auditions. The elegant ambiance and flexible booking options make it an excellent choice for private and corporate creative projects.

Event_Locations.name: FAT CAT
Event_Locations.description: Taking over the former Gasteig building, this massive cultural center features concert halls, seminar rooms, and a rooftop bar. It provides a versatile backdrop for theater performances, large-scale exhibitions, comedy nights, and community-driven arts festivals.

Event_Locations.name: Feierwerk Farbenladen
Event_Locations.description: Feierwerk Farbenladen is an exhibition space for young pop and subculture art in Munich. It hosts diverse visual art formats, offering emerging artists a low-barrier platform to present work in a bright, street-facing gallery connected to the Feierwerk cultural complex.

Event_Locations.name: Feierwerk Hansastraße
Event_Locations.description: This prominent venue features multiple halls including the Kranhalle and Orangehouse. Known for its excellent stage setups and robust infrastructure, it is a staple for local music events, lively parties, and dynamic cultural presentations.

Event_Locations.name: ForstHaus Mühltal
Event_Locations.description: This spacious venue stands out with its large open-air area and has hosted numerous events in the past. Recently, however, there have been restrictions due to noise protection conflicts at louder events.

Event_Locations.name: Forum 2
Event_Locations.description: A charming former cinema located in the heart of the Olympiadorf, ideal for film screenings, smaller concerts, and community gatherings. It features a 6 × 8 meter stage as well as a small gallery.

Event_Locations.name: Frau im Mond
Event_Locations.description: Frau im Mond, located atop Munich’s Deutsches Museum, is a rooftop event venue with panoramic views over the Isar and Alps. It offers flexible spaces, full technical equipment, professional services, and an accessible setting for intimate gatherings and larger events alike.

Event_Locations.name: Freiheitshalle
Event_Locations.description: Housed within a stunning historical brick building, this grand venue accommodates nearly four hundred guests. Outfitted with advanced multimedia technology, it is a premier destination for large techno raves, immersive theater, and high-profile corporate functions.

Event_Locations.name: Gans Woanders
Event_Locations.description: Kulturcafé Gans Woanders invites artists to apply for its cultural program. It provides stage, technical support, promotion, and basic compensation. Performances are subject to noise and weather constraints, with limited equipment allowed and outdoor conditions affecting scheduling.

Event_Locations.name: Gasteig HP8
Event_Locations.description: Providing state-of-the-art event halls, this expansive modern facility can host up to thousands of attendees. Featuring top-tier technical equipment and highly qualified staff, it is designed for major concerts, film screenings, and extensive international exhibitions.

Event_Locations.name: Giesinger Bahnhof
Event_Locations.description: This centrally located venue stands out with its flexible spaces for concerts and meetings. A special feature is the exclusive in-house catering, which must be arranged through the adjacent restaurant “Gleiswirtschaft.”

Event_Locations.name: Glockenbachwerkstatt
Event_Locations.description: The Bürgerhaus Glockenbachwerkstatt, Munich’s oldest community center, has operated since 1979 as an intergenerational sociocultural hub. Rooted in the city’s subcultural scene, it offers a diverse program in an open, inclusive atmosphere that welcomes people of all identities and backgrounds.

Event_Locations.name: Goldberg Studios
Event_Locations.description: Offering impressive ceiling heights up to eight meters and heavy-duty power supplies, these professional studios are explicitly tailored for demanding film and photo productions. The facility also includes a fully equipped kitchen and accessible ground-floor entry.

Event_Locations.name: Goldener Reiter
Event_Locations.description: A legendary, dark basement club right in the city center, primarily focused on house music. Its deep black aesthetic makes it a great, atmospheric venue for underground parties.

Event_Locations.name: Grete
Event_Locations.description: A decentralized cultural platform activating public and private spaces in Freiham through pop-up cinema, music, performances, and community-led events. GRETE transforms neighborhoods into temporary stages, supporting participatory formats, local initiatives, and collaborative cultural production in accessible, everyday environments.

Event_Locations.name: HALLE 6
Event_Locations.description: This dynamic space offers multiple studios and a dedicated workshop area. With highly customizable setups and technical support available upon request, it is an essential hub for large-format artistic projects, intensive theater rehearsals, and community workshops.

Event_Locations.name: halle50
Event_Locations.description: halle50 is a ~200 m² exhibition space within DomagkAteliers, used for exhibitions, performances, concerts, and interdisciplinary projects. It can be rented at reduced rates, with bookings awarded through an application process reviewed by a curatorial board.

Event_Locations.name: HochX
Event_Locations.description: Functioning primarily as a theater space, this venue provides fixed seating for audiences and a versatile foyer equipped with a bar. It serves as an intimate setting for performing arts, award ceremonies, and interactive multimedia presentations.

Event_Locations.name: HOLA Bar
Event_Locations.description: An extremely charming, small bar run by a very friendly operator. During parties, the basement area is often opened and quickly turned into a second dance floor.

Event_Locations.name: Impact Hub München
Event_Locations.description: As a thriving coworking space, this location features diverse environments including meeting rooms and a lively marketplace area. It is heavily utilized for entrepreneurial workshops, team meetings, and networking events aimed at driving innovative community projects.

Event_Locations.name: Import Export
Event_Locations.description: Import Export is a non-profit socio-cultural venue hosting concerts, workshops, performances, and festivals. With a focus on experimental and global music, it provides an inclusive, collaborative space for artists, communities, and interdisciplinary exchange within Munich’s Kreativquartier, both indoors and open-air.

Event_Locations.name: KADE
Event_Locations.description: KADE is a legendary StuSta club in the MKH front building. Recently renovated, it hosts weekly student parties. Residents can also rent it for private events like birthdays by filling out a form and checking availability.

Event_Locations.name: Karli17
Event_Locations.description: A temporary cultural space in Moosach hosting exhibitions, performances, and community-driven projects. Karli17 transforms vacant residential space into an accessible platform for artistic exchange, experimentation, and public engagement, supporting local artists and initiatives in a collaborative, low-threshold environment.

Event_Locations.name: Köşk
Event_Locations.description: Köşk is an open, youth-oriented cultural space near Munich’s main station, hosting exhibitions, concerts, workshops, and participatory projects. It fosters dialogue between artists and audiences, encouraging collaboration, experimentation, and community engagement in an accessible, non-commercial environment.

Event_Locations.name: KulturBunt Neuperlach
Event_Locations.description: NA

Event_Locations.name: Kulturhaus Milbertshofen
Event_Locations.description: Kulturhaus Milbertshofen is Munich’s largest district cultural center, located at Curt-Mezger-Platz in a diverse neighborhood. It hosts concerts, readings, theatre, workshops, and community events, offering space, support, and opportunities for creative and social engagement.

Event_Locations.name: KulturLaden Westend
Event_Locations.description: KulturLaden Westend is a non-commercial, community-run venue in Munich, offering space for public activities. Managed voluntarily and largely funded by the city, it supports self-organized events, prioritizes accessibility through low-cost participation, and fosters inclusive, non-profit cultural exchange within the neighborhood.

Event_Locations.name: Kunst Block Balve
Event_Locations.description: Tucked away near industrial tracks, this massive complex boasts four distinct, flexible rooms including a fully equipped stage. It is renowned for hosting spectacular art installations, underground raves, and modern corporate conferences.

Event_Locations.name: Lieber Scholli
Event_Locations.description: Situated within a repurposed paper factory, this gritty industrial venue features a large ground-floor room and a captivating basement. It provides comprehensive rental packages including sound equipment, making it a favorite for memorable parties and concerts.

Event_Locations.name: LIVE.EVIL
Event_Locations.description: A full-fledged live club with an integrated stage, bar, and lounge area. It also features a huge terrace and its own restaurant, offering comprehensive, tailor-made event packages.

Event_Locations.name: Lost Weekend
Event_Locations.description: A centrally located venue combining café, bar, and stage, hosting live music, readings, and community events. With open booking formats and frequent programming, it supports emerging artists and offers a flexible space for performances, cultural exchange, and independent initiatives.

Event_Locations.name: LUISE
Event_Locations.description: LUISE is a community-oriented cultural center in Munich offering spaces for initiatives, artists, and groups. It hosts diverse programs including readings, concerts, theater, workshops, and counseling, while supporting civic engagement and collaborative cultural and educational projects.

Event_Locations.name: Macherei
Event_Locations.description: Blending striking modern architecture with raw industrial charm, this venue includes a sleek infinity cove and an open design kitchen. It is perfectly configured for stylish corporate pitches, high-end video productions, and sophisticated creative networking sessions.

Event_Locations.name: MaximiliansForum
Event_Locations.description: MaximiliansForum is a public art space in Munich located in a 1600 sqm underground passage near Maximilianstraße. It presents interdisciplinary exhibitions, performances, and workshops, offering free, 24/7 access and fostering exchange within the city’s contemporary and emerging art scene.

Event_Locations.name: Mister B.'s
Event_Locations.description: Mister B.’s is a cozy 30 sqm bar in Munich accommodating up to 40 guests. It offers food, drinks, and space for DJs or live bands, with flexible seating and a private atmosphere ensured by an additional silencer fee.

Event_Locations.name: Mohr-Villa
Event_Locations.description: Mohr-Villa is a community-driven cultural center in Munich, supported by a non-profit association and the city. It hosts diverse programs across multiple buildings, including workshops, theater, and social initiatives, fostering creativity, volunteer engagement, and local cultural participation.

Event_Locations.name: MUCCA Halle
Event_Locations.description: This venue is a versatile space for artistic production, rehearsals, and presentations across disciplines. It functions as a training hall for dance, theater, and contemporary circus, and hosts exhibitions, meetings, seminars, and events with basic lighting and sound equipment.

Event_Locations.name: Muffatwerk (Ampere / Muffathalle)
Event_Locations.description: The well-known cultural center on the Isar includes the massive Muffathalle, the stylish Ampere Club with gallery, and the Muffatcafé. The spaces offer state-of-the-art technical infrastructure for large concerts and events.

Event_Locations.name: Munich Beach Resort
Event_Locations.description: This spacious beach bar at the former Olympic grandstand features a cool concrete aesthetic and six beach volleyball courts. As the venue of the “Isle of Summer” festival, it’s an excellent outdoor location for summer events.

Event_Locations.name: Munich Urban Colab
Event_Locations.description: Spanning an immense eleven thousand square meters, this cutting-edge complex encompasses event spaces, a high-tech MakerSpace, and vibrant community areas. It acts as a central focal point for Munich's tech and creative industries to seamlessly collaborate.

Event_Locations.name: Music Club München
Event_Locations.description: A spacious club in the north of Munich, offering enough room for medium-sized events. Rental prices vary depending on the day of the week, with noticeably higher costs on the more in-demand weekend days.

Event_Locations.name: Orbit
Event_Locations.description: This unique location consists of a cozy double container with its own bar and a small outdoor area. It is located on the grounds of Bahnwärter Thiel and offers service packages for private events.

Event_Locations.name: Pasinger Hütte
Event_Locations.description: An extremely charming venue with a raw container-style aesthetic. It also features a small outdoor area and is ideal for laid-back, alternative open-air parties.

Event_Locations.name: PATHOS theater
Event_Locations.description: PATHOS Theater Munich is an independent production venue supporting diverse, interdisciplinary performances. Artists can apply by submitting a project concept to the artistic directors. While funding is limited, the theater offers guidance, letters of intent, and space for experimental, non-commercial productions.

Event_Locations.name: Pimpernel
Event_Locations.description: Pimpernel is a legendary Munich nightclub, active since 1970, known for its vibrant atmosphere and late-night energy. Open daily, it features local and international DJs, offering an iconic space to dance, socialize, and experience the city’s nightlife culture.

Event_Locations.name: Prygoshin Backroom
Event_Locations.description: From the outside, the venue looks like a completely unremarkable small restaurant. The real highlight, however, is hidden in the back: a genuine secret club room behind a heavy steel door.

Event_Locations.name: Schlossallee / BÜRO GRANDEZZA
Event_Locations.description: Schlossallee by Büro Grandezza is a creative hub in Unterhaching, transforming a former community building into shared studios, workshops, and labs. It fosters artistic collaboration, experimentation, and networking, creating affordable space and a vibrant community for Munich’s independent cultural scene.

Event_Locations.name: schwere reiter
Event_Locations.description: schwere reiter is a production and performance venue in Munich’s Kreativquartier, supporting interdisciplinary projects of the independent arts scene. It provides space, technical equipment, and staff support, and welcomes volunteers to contribute to its non-profit cultural activities.

Event_Locations.name: Senatore
Event_Locations.description: A small, extremely charming bar with a club-like vibe right at Sendlinger Tor. Thanks to its location and stylish atmosphere, it’s especially well suited for early evening house raves.

Event_Locations.name: Sendlinger Kulturschmiede
Event_Locations.description: The Sendlinger Kulturschmiede, founded in 1978 in Munich’s Sendling district, is a vibrant cultural hub. Exhibitions, concerts, readings, theater, film, talks, performances, and workshops shape its program, fostering exchange, inspiration, and strong community connections among artists and residents.

Event_Locations.name: Skateschule
Event_Locations.description: Operating primarily as a large indoor skate park, this expansive hall offers an undeniably raw and energetic atmosphere. It has proven to be a uniquely engaging, unconventional venue perfectly suited for hosting underground electronic music raves and parties.

Event_Locations.name: Spagat Theater
Event_Locations.description: Spagat Theater, founded in 2018 in Munich’s Domagkpark, is a socio-cultural stage offering theater, music, and performance. As part of HORIZONT e.V., it focuses on socially relevant themes, participatory projects, and inclusive artistic exchange within the community.

Event_Locations.name: Stadtteilkultur 2411
Event_Locations.description: Stadtteilkultur 2411 is a community-driven cultural space in Munich hosting exhibitions, concerts, readings, film nights, and workshops. It offers rehearsal spaces, networking, and support for creatives to showcase, collaborate, and share their work in an open, welcoming environment.

Event_Locations.name: Substanz
Event_Locations.description: This traditional pub features a well-integrated dance floor in the back. As it hosts its own events on many days, it may be more difficult to book for external rentals.

Event_Locations.name: Sugar Mountain
Event_Locations.description: A vast venue spanning 7,500 square meters of outdoor space and 2,000 square meters indoors. This impressive location is perfectly suited for massive raves, festivals, and other large-scale cultural events.

Event_Locations.name: Trambahnhäusl
Event_Locations.description: The Trambahnhäusl is a space dedicated to ideas, creativity, and active engagement, with a strong focus on (sub)cultural initiatives. If you have a concept you’d like to realize or want to get involved, feel free to reach out

Event_Locations.name: ubo9
Event_Locations.description: The district cultural center ubo9 serves as an event venue, cultural hub, and meeting space for communities in Aubing and surrounding neighborhoods. It promotes local cultural life through diverse programs, collaborations, and regular events, actively involving residents, artists, and organizations.

Event_Locations.name: Unter Deck
Event_Locations.description: A stylish bar with a rustic wooden aesthetic, covered all over in stickers and graffiti. In the back, there’s a dance floor as well as an extremely cool, uniquely designed backstage area.

Event_Locations.name: Utopia
Event_Locations.description: Situated in a historically significant, pillar-free former riding hall, this sprawling venue beautifully merges classic ambiance with cutting-edge technology. It is a premier location suitable for grand theatrical performances, extensive literature readings, and large-scale exhibitions.

Event_Locations.name: whiteBOX
Event_Locations.description: whiteBOX is a 272 sqm multifunctional event space in Munich’s Werksviertel-Mitte, near Ostbahnhof. With its raw industrial aesthetic, it hosts exhibitions, conferences, symposia, and cultural events, serving as a central venue within the district’s creative and artistic landscape.

Event_Locations.name: YOU Loft / YOU
Event_Locations.description: The venue consists of a large main room as well as a smaller, completely black-painted room on the upper floor. For contractual reasons, security personnel must be booked through the landlord when renting the space.

Event_Locations.name: Zirka
Event_Locations.description: Revitalizing a former industrial hall, this location provides soaring ceilings, vast windows, and distinct architectural features like skylights. It serves as an expansive canvas for cultural exhibitions, co-working, and large-scale, immersive artistic productions in Munich.

Event_Locations.name: Zur Gruam
Event_Locations.description: Zur Gruam is a small afterhours club and bar near Alte Utting, known for its raw, underground atmosphere. Once a rough dive, it now attracts a young crowd dancing to techno and electronic music in an intimate, unpolished setting.

Event_Locations.name: Feierwerk: Orangehouse
Event_Locations.description: Feierwerk Orangehouse is a versatile venue in Munich known for concerts, club nights, and cultural events, especially alternative and electronic music. With a spacious hall and strong sound system, it attracts diverse crowds and supports emerging artists and underground scenes.

Event_Locations.name: Feierwerk: Kranhalle
Event_Locations.description: Der große breite Raum, wenn man reingeht ganz rechts an der Bar vorbei.

Event_Locations.name: Feierwerk: Hansa 39
Event_Locations.description: Feierwerk Kranhalle is a flexible event space within Feierwerk, hosting concerts, parties, and cultural events. With high ceilings, industrial aesthetics, and professional sound and lighting, it supports diverse formats and atmospheres for both live music and creative productions.

Event_Locations.name: Freiheitshalle
Event_Locations.description: Freiheitshalle München is a former industrial brick hall near Donnersberger Brücke, now hosting concerts, parties, and cultural events. With ~400 m² space, high ceilings, and up to 1,000 capacity, it suits large club nights and immersive productions.

Residencies.name: Artist in Residence
Residencies.description: This municipal initiative provides international creatives with dedicated living spaces, working environments, and financial backing. It fosters critical discourse and allows participants to deeply engage with their art while connecting with the local cultural community.

Residencies.name: Halle 6 Residency
Residencies.description: Providing guest studios and housing for visiting international artists, this program is booked on a semiannual basis. It strongly emphasizes artistic exchange and features the 'Artist at Risk' initiative alongside regular symposia for comprehensive creative collaboration.

Residencies.name: Schafhof European Art Fellowship
Residencies.description: This European exchange program brings artists from across the continent to Upper Bavaria for residencies lasting one to three months. In return, regional artists travel abroad, promoting profound cross-cultural dialogue and enriching the broader European artistic landscape.

Residencies.name: Writers Residency
Residencies.description: Tailored specifically for authors, critics, and artists focused on written work, this residency offers a stipend and accommodation. It provides essential time and space for writing, culminating in public readings that explore fiction outside conventional exhibition formats.

Residencies.name: Residency at PATHOS Theater
Residencies.description: A short-term residency offering rehearsal space and technical support for performing arts projects, typically lasting 1–3 weeks. Artists develop process-oriented work and may present showings or workshops. Funding, travel, and accommodation must be secured through external grants.

Art_Studios.name: Atelierhaus Baumstraße
Art_Studios.description: Housing around fifty artists across various disciplines like visual arts and architecture, this facility awards long-term spaces through a jury process. The building periodically opens its doors to the public, fostering neighborhood engagement and artistic visibility.

Art_Studios.name: Atelierpark
Art_Studios.description: Bahnwärter Thiel is a Munich-based cultural venue and club operating as a temporary-use space. Built from repurposed containers and train parts, it hosts nightlife, exhibitions, and performances, with art studios integrated into the containers, emphasizing DIY aesthetics and interdisciplinary cultural exchange.

Art_Studios.name: AtelierWerkstatt
Art_Studios.description: The studio spans approx. 180 m² and includes divided work areas, a kitchenette, restrooms, Wi-Fi, tools, and equipment. It offers easels, printing and sewing tools, upcycling materials, and supplies for painting, sculpting, and crafting, with consumables charged separately.

Art_Studios.name: BBK - Atelierbörse
Art_Studios.description: Operating as an online marketplace, this platform lists currently available studio spaces and allows artists to post requests. The Cultural Department actively supports this initiative by offering rent grants and subsidized studios on a three-year cycle.

Art_Studios.name: DomagkAteliers
Art_Studios.description: DomagkAteliers is one of Europe’s largest artist studio complexes, hosting around 140 international artists across 100+ studios. Located in Munich’s Domagkpark, it also features exhibition space halle50, public events, and open studio days, with spaces available for rent.

Art_Studios.name: Gabriele Space
Art_Studios.description: An IMAL project that revitalizes vacant buildings to offer free studios and workshops for emerging creators. The initiative prioritizes non-commercial, community-driven experimentation and skill-sharing, aiming to empower young artists while actively engaging the surrounding neighborhood.

Art_Studios.name: GEDOKmuc
Art_Studios.description: GEDOKmuc is Munich’s largest interdisciplinary network for women artists, part of a historic Europe-wide organization. It supports artists across disciplines through exhibitions, residencies, and advocacy, promoting visibility, equal opportunities, and stronger representation of women in the cultural sector.

Art_Studios.name: Goldberg Studios
Art_Studios.description: Goldberg Studios is a centrally located Munich venue offering fully equipped spaces for photo and film shoots, events, exhibitions, and conferences. It provides comprehensive services including concept development, technical setup, lighting, sound, decoration, and catering.

Art_Studios.name: GOROD
Art_Studios.description: GOROD is a cultural center in Munich operated by the non-profit organization GIK (Society for Integration and Culture in Europe). Founded in 1998, it promotes integration, cultural exchange, and community support through social programs, education, arts, and initiatives for migrants and refugees.

Art_Studios.name: H.ALLE
Art_Studios.description: Operating as an open workspace accessible every Saturday, this location provides shared tools and hosts diverse, rotating workshops including ceramics and printmaking. It is explicitly designed to encourage collaborative creative endeavors and welcomes families into its environment.

Art_Studios.name: H.ALLE
Art_Studios.description: A shared, open-access atelier offering tools and workspace for independent creative production. IMAL Halle provides equipment for printing, textiles, and crafts, enabling artists to experiment, develop projects, and work collaboratively in a flexible, community-oriented environment with optional guidance and workshops.

Art_Studios.name: Haus2 e.V.
Art_Studios.description: Part of the KreativLabor community, this collaborative project allocates its culturally focused spaces via a jury selection. Although currently offered at standard commercial rates, the organization is actively working toward establishing more affordable long-term conditions for creatives.

Art_Studios.name: Isar Atelier
Art_Studios.description: Situated close to the Isar river, this warm and fully equipped studio features a shared working room, a cozy kitchen, and bathroom facilities. It offers artists a welcoming community atmosphere in a highly desirable Munich neighborhood.

Art_Studios.name: Karli17
Art_Studios.description: A flexible creative workspace offering studios, workshops, and tools for artistic production. Karli17 enables artists to develop projects, collaborate, and experiment, with access to shared facilities, rehearsal spaces, and resources in a community-oriented, low-cost environment for independent creatives.

Art_Studios.name: KUNSTLABOR 2
Art_Studios.description: Occupying a massive floor above active exhibition spaces, this center houses forty individual studios. The environment is designed to promote cross-genre collaboration among its resident artists and frequently hosts public open studio events to showcase works.

Art_Studios.name: Leonrod-Haus
Art_Studios.description: Serving as a multidisciplinary hub for art and film since 2011, this venue unites various creative practices under one roof. The resident artists have established an official association to boost their visibility and organize public festivals.

Art_Studios.name: Leonrodhaus
Art_Studios.description: A multidisciplinary studio house within Munich’s Kreativquartier, hosting artists, filmmakers, and cultural initiatives. Leonrodhaus provides workspaces, collaboration opportunities, and community-driven formats like open studios, supporting independent artistic production across visual art, film, and performing arts in a non-commercial environment.

Art_Studios.name: NODEPRESSIONROOM
Art_Studios.description: Originating during the pandemic in a former pharmacy, this collective now operates as a registered nonprofit. It provides affordable workspace for numerous artists alongside an active exhibition area, regularly hosting vernissages and fostering a strong creative community.

Art_Studios.name: PLATFORM
Art_Studios.description: Housed in a transformed industrial building, this expansive facility features twenty-three bright studios accommodating forty professional artists. Residents are carefully selected through an application process, ensuring a high-quality, dedicated community managed by the Münchner Arbeit gGmbH.

Art_Studios.name: super+ Pineapple Ateliers
Art_Studios.description: Creative studio spaces in Pineapple Park with 24/7 access, shared kitchen and lifts. Ground floor units offer high ceilings and outdoor areas. Includes café, kiosk, parcel station and strong community atmosphere. Not suitable for band rehearsal.

Art_Studios.name: WERKRAUM III
Art_Studios.description: WERKRAUM is a recurring cultural format at Kopfbau that brings together artists, open studios, workshops, and social spaces. It emphasizes accessibility, creative exchange, and community engagement, creating a platform for interdisciplinary artistic practices and informal encounters.

Sound_Studios.name: Ackermannbogen e.V. Kultur Büro
Sound_Studios.description: The "KreativGarage" rehearsal space is available day and night. Equipment includes a piano, drum kit, projector, and DJ system.

Sound_Studios.name: Anytime Music Studios
Sound_Studios.description: Ground-floor studios with natural light and excellent pianos are bookable 24/7 via an app. They are ideal for practicing, teaching, and recording demos.

Sound_Studios.name: Coworking Holzschuh
Sound_Studios.description: Offers a SmallBox for acoustic instruments and a BigBox with a piano, kitchenette, and Wi-Fi. The rooms can be rented for single or regular sessions.

Sound_Studios.name: Dreivierteleins
Sound_Studios.description: Five rehearsal spaces are accessible 24 hours a day. The rooms range from a small studio control room to a large band room.

Sound_Studios.name: Einstein-Kulturzentrum
Sound_Studios.description: Rehearsal rooms are equipped with a projector, screen, and lighting and sound systems. Booking periods run from September to July.

Sound_Studios.name: Feierwerk - Südpolstation
Sound_Studios.description: Soundproof band rehearsal rooms are perfectly suited for young musicians and upcoming bands. They include instruments and amps for fixed 3-hour weekly slots.

Sound_Studios.name: Freizeitstätte Hirschgarten – Laut Sein
Sound_Studios.description: This music rehearsal room features a backline and PA system. It is open Monday through Sunday from 8:00 PM to 1:00 AM.

Sound_Studios.name: Funkstation
Sound_Studios.description: These fully equipped, soundproof rooms are intended for young musicians. Bands can secure a fixed 3-hour rehearsal slot per week.

Sound_Studios.name: Gasteig – Probensaal
Sound_Studios.description: A large rehearsal hall capable of holding up to 190 people. It features floor-to-ceiling sound reduction curtains and allows for flexible stage setups.

Sound_Studios.name: Giesinger Rockpalast
Sound_Studios.description: These music rehearsal spaces offer flexible equipment rentals. Additional gear like E-pianos, guitars, and basses can be booked in advance via email.

Sound_Studios.name: Glen Miller
Sound_Studios.description: An air-conditioned and acoustically optimized rehearsal room for up to 8 people. It is fully equipped with drums, amps, an E-piano, and a mixer.

Sound_Studios.name: Halle 6
Sound_Studios.description: Ground-level, heated workspaces for temporary use by professional artists. The facility provides two large studios and one small room, offering dance floors and projectors.

Sound_Studios.name: HochX
Sound_Studios.description: Provides the right working environment for dance, theater, or performance projects. A dedicated storage space for small stage pieces and props is also available.

Sound_Studios.name: Kultur im Trafo
Sound_Studios.description: A music rehearsal room offering optimal acoustics. It can be booked in 2.5-hour slots per week through their online portal.

Sound_Studios.name: Kulturhaus Milbertshofen
Sound_Studios.description: A soundproof room equipped with a PC running Ableton Live, monitors, and rental mics. A minimum 4-hour booking and liability insurance are required.

Sound_Studios.name: Kulturprojekt München
Sound_Studios.description: Music rehearsal rooms accessible 24/7 where subletting is permitted. Contracts require a two-month deposit and have a two-month notice period.

Sound_Studios.name: Movimento
Sound_Studios.description: A central venue offering a teaching room, ensemble room, and a concert space seating 100 people. It provides an appealing atmosphere with attentive service for culture and business.

Sound_Studios.name: Muffatwerk: Studio I und II
Sound_Studios.description: Large studios primarily serving as rehearsal spaces for dance and theater, multimedia workshops, or exhibitions. Studio 1 includes private shower and toilet facilities.

Sound_Studios.name: MusicLab / Stadtbibliothek HP8
Sound_Studios.description: A soundproof room inside the city library for singing and playing instruments. It includes recording equipment and mics, requiring personal reservation for the current month.

Sound_Studios.name: Pasinger Fabrik: Studio 1 und 2
Sound_Studios.description: Dance and music rehearsal spaces for 30-50 people within a municipal cultural center. The venue hosts diverse artistic, social, and youth programs.

Sound_Studios.name: Silver-Stage
Sound_Studios.description: Professional recording studio and rehearsal spaces. The Stageroom features a stage and PA system, while the Lightroom offers a mirror wall and custom lighting.

Sound_Studios.name: The Latin-Groove School
Sound_Studios.description: Two fully equipped, air-conditioned rooms ideal for individuals or small bands. They can be booked flexibly starting from 30-minute sessions or via 10-packs.

Sound_Studios.name: Tonkünstler München e.V.
Sound_Studios.description: Offers the Rubinstein Hall with a Steinway grand piano, and three teaching studios. Ideal for chamber music rehearsals, lessons, and concerts.

Sound_Studios.name: Treibhaus Musikraum
Sound_Studios.description: A youth-friendly music room available for 2 hours per week. It is fully equipped and gives bands the chance to perform at an annual band festival.

Sound_Studios.name: Turmkeller
Sound_Studios.description: Features 43 soundproofed rooms with internet and ventilation. Users can join a newsletter to be notified when a new room becomes available.

Sound_Studios.name: WAGNISART Musikräume
Sound_Studios.description: Offers three rooms for regular use. The Yellow and Green rooms are exclusively for unplugged instruments, while the Orange room accommodates bands with amplifiers.
